recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀輕鏈散佈圖（Lambda PE 對 Kappa FITC），在單一細胞閘門中 Kappa 陽性佔 99.60%、Lambda 僅 0.09%；幾乎全為單一 Kappa 輕鏈表現，代表克隆性（輕鏈限制），支持漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Bivariate dot plot gated on singlets: Lambda PE (x-axis) versus Kappa FITC (y-axis)
Kappa-positive events account for 99.60% of the gated population
Small double-positive (D++) and double-negative (D--) regions with few events
Kappa:lambda ratio markedly skewed, indicating monotypic kappa expression
describe_en: Flow cytometric light-chain analysis on the gated singlet population shows 99.60% kappa-positive and 0.09% lambda-positive events, with only minor double-positive and double-negative events. This markedly skewed kappa:lambda ratio indicates kappa light-chain restriction. Assuming the analysis is gated on plasma cells with cytoplasmic light-chain staining, findings demonstrate a clonal kappa-restricted plasma cell population consistent with plasma cell myeloma in the appropriate clinical and morphologic context.
